environment.description: Application deployed identically but the ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains a single rule group reference: the AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet' with all rules set to Count mode EXCEPT 'SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS' which uses the default BLOCK action with sensitivity level HIGH. Additionally, the WebACL default action is ALLOW. The application also runs behind a CloudFront distribution with origin set to the ALB, and CloudFront has a separate WebACL with the 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' in BLOCK mode (which includes SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING limiting query strings to 2048 bytes). The SQLite database is mounted from an EFS volume with encryption in transit enabled.

config.database: SQLite 3.40 on EFS with encryption in transit
config.security_group: inbound 443 from CloudFront prefix list only
